Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of the roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle attempted a lane
change to the right. Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the adjacent lane, was unable to avoid contact, and the two
vehicles sideswiped one another along their passenger-side and driver-side panels. Driver 1 stated that the impact
caused neck and back pain, and the reported symptoms are consistent with the forces typical of a collision of this
kind. Damage visible on both vehicles lines up with the described point of contact, and photographs taken at the
scene confirm several of the details provided by the drivers. No independent witnesses were located, and no one else
observed the collision itself. Officers confirmed through statements from the drivers and from the Passenger, who
was seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle, that the Passenger was present at the time of impact. Responding
officers found no indication of prior damage to the vehicle involved. Records checked at the scene show that Driver 1
is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy covering that vehicle.
